params.name: leadId
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lead record to convert. Must be a valid Lead ID that exists in the CRM and has not been previously converted.

items.docs: Converts a Lead record into Contact, Account, and/or Deal records. Allows configuration of conversion behavior including overwrite settings, notifications, owner assignment, and tag carryover.

params.name: job_id
params.description: Identifier of the mass convert job to fetch status for.

items.docs: Retrieve the status and counts of a previously scheduled mass convert job using job_id query parameter.
Start a scheduled mass-convert job that converts multiple leads into other modules (Deals/Contacts/Accounts) according to provided options. Max 50 lead IDs per request.

params.name: leadId
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lead record to retrieve conversion options for

items.docs: Retrieves available conversion options for a lead including matching contacts, accounts, field mappings, and layout preferences. This endpoint helps determine what conversion paths are available before performing the actual lead conversion.
